title: Reason Code 33/72: the user must change their password, and cannot do it over this connection
plain_english: The account is flagged 'user must change password at next logon', or the password has expired. A password change over PEAP-MSCHAPv2 is only possible if the network policy allows it and the supplicant supports it, and most Wi-Fi and VPN clients do not. Until the password is changed somewhere else, every attempt is denied.

causes.cause: The password expired or the must-change flag is set on the account.
causes.next_check: Check the account in Active Directory Users and Computers (Account tab, and 'pwdLastSet'); have the user change the password on a domain-joined machine or through self-service reset, then reconnect.

causes.cause: The policy forbids password change after expiry, so the client cannot fix it in-band.
causes.next_check: NPS console > Network Policies > the matching policy > Constraints > Authentication Methods > enable 'User can change password after it has expired' (only helps for clients that support it).
